deoxygenation_method: Offline argon sparging of EtOH/pH 9 buffer (5:1 v/v) for ≥20 min; feed solution prepared and transferred to sealed reservoir under argon headspace; argon blanket maintained on reservoir during pumping; Stage 1 tubing purged with degassed solvent before run. No inline degasser used (hard constraint).

topology_operations.label: Pump A — Single pre-mixed, pre-degassed feed containing substrate, Michael acceptor, and photocatalyst in EtOH/pH 9 buffer (5:1 v/v). All dissolved in degassed solvent, stored under argon headspace. Single pump stream avoids dilution and ensures correct stoichiometry.
PhotoCoil — Photoredox Giese radical addition (C–C bond formation)

MFC B — Air introduced via MFC through T-mixer between Stage 1 and Stage 2 coils. Segmented gas-liquid (Taylor) flow provides high O₂ mass transfer. Air at ~0.5–1.0 sccm provides excess O₂ for sulfoxidation.
